checkpoint: Real synthetic CPU model generation and active cancellation on a nominal 10 GiB emulator

model.input: Fixed synthetic generation prompt and synthetic cancellation prompt only

metricScope.generatedUtf16: Actual nonempty generated result length: 111 UTF-16 code units; no accuracy evaluation.
metricScope.generationElapsedMillis: 58,576 ms for the generation operation including native initialization; emulator observation only.
metricScope.cancellationOperationMillis: 17,295 ms for the complete cancellation operation including native initialization; this is not cancellation-request latency.
metricScope.nativeCancellationCalls: 204 successful native cancel API calls were observed while the synchronous send was active.
metricScope.nativeSendFailures: One native synchronous-send failure was observed in the deliberately cancelled operation; the test caught CancellationException and completed its assertions.
metricScope.timeout: Joined watchdog/cancellation observed returning in this execution; no hard native timeout or process-isolation guarantee.

memorySampling.scope: Periodic numeric memory of only the phase-identified synthetic CI test PID; observed samples can miss peaks and do not establish a phone RAM minimum.

memoryEvidenceLimitation: Confirmed transcript-filter tr buffering withheld phase PID output until instrumentation completed. The sampler recorded zero PID samples and zero RSS/HWM samples; its zero-valued maxima are absence of measurement, not zero process memory. No measured RAM minimum follows.

canaryScope.timing: Bounded scans before generation and after cancellation/cleanup
canaryScope.publicModelExclusion: Only the exact separately hash-verified public model was excluded.
canaryScope.limitations: Synthetic marker absence in these scans does not establish continuous file cleanliness, complete plaintext absence, memory/log privacy or traffic inspection.

artifact.independentVerificationScope: Root reviewer downloaded the exact 7,208-byte synthetic report ZIP and independently verified its SHA-256 before this checkpoint.

priorSixGiBProbe.observed: Process exited after NATIVE_GENERATION_START and before NATIVE_SEND_STARTED; no generation or cancellation pass.
priorSixGiBProbe.scope: A failure in this nominal 6 GiB emulator and a pass in the nominal 10 GiB emulator do not establish a minimum RAM requirement or a physical-phone compatibility boundary.

separatePlannedUiGuard.scope: Conservative CPU diagnostic gate being prepared separately for phones in the 12 GB class. This run does not validate that application build, establish a measured model RAM minimum, or prove any phone will pass the gate or run the model.

limits: One fresh, non-skipped synthetic test executed; no representative language/task/QA accuracy evaluation.
No process RSS/HWM measurements were collected; no RAM minimum claim.
The emulator used 4,096-byte pages; real 16 KiB native loading is not established.
No physical phone, fingerprint/vendor path, phone latency, thermal, battery or sustained-memory result.
Bounded synthetic file-canary and public-model hash checks are narrower than comprehensive privacy or traffic inspection.
No hard native cancellation deadline, process isolation, complete dependency provenance/notices, recovery or release-readiness claim.
Normal document questions/summaries remain disabled; this evidence does not complete M4.
evidenceScope: Real public-model CPU generation with synthetic prompt; observed native cancel API success and synchronous-send failure; narrow file-canary scan. No phone latency, model accuracy, complete privacy, hard timeout or RAM minimum claim. Memory sampling may be delayed by tr buffering.
